recommended_primary: Medication omission – missing antiplatelet therapy (clinical safety gap)
review_summary: The differential captured most relevant entities but mis‑prioritized them and omitted uncontrolled hypertension. Probabilities were adjusted to reflect the strength of evidence, especially elevating the antiplatelet omission and reactive thrombocytosis while reducing speculative diagnoses. Additional data (renal labs, sleep study, iron studies, cardiac imaging) are needed to refine several lower‑probability items.
